items.text: Requirements and active scope are coherent.
Required automated tests and quality checks pass.
Integration tests pass when behavior crosses module, service, or persistence boundaries.
Hurl or fixture-based deployed API validation passes when deployed API behavior changes.
Visible UI acceptance and test/dev URL validation pass for user-visible behavior.
The change is deployed and validated in the dev environment.
Required review feedback is resolved and the change is ready to merge.
Feature-demo applicability is decided and evidenced.
